description: This file implements URL parsing and encoding/decoding functions within the WPEFramework's Core namespace. It defines methods for URL encoding, decoding, Base64 encoding/decoding, and parsing URL components such as scheme, host, port, path, query, and fragment. It also includes a class method for reconstructing the URL as a string.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: A class representing a URL, capable of parsing URL strings into components and reconstructing them.

methods.name: URL::Encode
methods.description: Encodes a source string into a URL-encoded format.

methods.name: URL::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string back to its original form.

methods.name: URL::Base64Encode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a Base64 string.

methods.name: URL::Base64Decode
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string into binary data.

methods.name: URL::Parse
methods.description: Parses a URL string into its components: scheme, host, port, path, query, and fragment.

methods.name: URL::ParseDomain
methods.description: Parses the domain part of a URL, extracting hostname and port.

methods.name: URL::Text
methods.description: Reconstructs the URL from its components into a string.
